sections.text:
Item #1: Scientists discover quadruple helix DNA in human cells.
Item #2: Researchers find that bilingual children have a significantly higher IQ score compared to matched monolingual controls.
Item #3: Scientists discover the mechanism by which the single-celled organism, Tetrahymena thermophile, has seven sexes.

The Skeptics' Guide to the Universe is produced by SGU Productions, dedicated to promoting science and critical thinking.
